purpose: Token flow data for Claude Code (Anthropic Opus) — shows how 280K turns produce 45B prompt-side tokens, and how cache mechanics transform that into modest energy use.
source: Sampling of ~/.claude/projects/-Users-dereklomas-sourcelibrary/ JSONL session logs (11.9% by bytes, extrapolated)

per_token_J._note: From the v4 bottom-up model. Real values likely 2-3× higher per production-overhead corrections.

notes: Output tokens are 0.3% of the token count but ~60% of the energy.
Cache reads are 96% of the token count but only ~25% of the energy.
Cache reads cost ~10% of fresh input per token because the KV cache skips most of the compute (no MLP forward pass).
If we had no caching and every token were 'fresh', the same dev work would consume roughly 30-50× more energy.
